data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var eliminated (RED phase)
- DD4: merge-to-main-pr.sh consumes dso.workflow without MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE (RED phase)
- DD5: TDD RED phase

## What to Change
The env var MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE is exported by merge-to-main-pr.sh and read by
merge-to-main-direct.sh's _phase_version_bump to determine commit strategy (new commit vs amend).

New behavior: merge-to-main-direct.sh reads `dso.workflow` from read-config.sh instead of
checking MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE to determine pr-mode vs direct-mode version bump.

Modify `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` (covers merge-to-main-pr.sh):
- Add test: after merging, MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE is NOT set in the environment
- Add test: version bump produces a new commit (not amend) when dso.workflow=ci-pr, WITHOUT MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE being set externally

Modify `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh` OR `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh`
(whichever covers merge-to-main-direct.sh's _phase_version_bump):
- Add test: _phase_version_bump uses dso.workflow=ci-pr to decide new-commit vs amend
  (Given: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE with dso.workflow=ci-pr, When: version bump runs, Then: new commit created, MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE is NOT in the environment)

These tests MUST FAIL before Task 10 (scripts still use MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE).

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Update .test-index for `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` and `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-direct.sh`:
Add RED markers for the new test function names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — suite with RED markers
  Verify: bash -c 'grep "\[test_version_bump_uses_dso_workflow" .test-index && echo "RED marker present"'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Test file(s) contain assertions about dso.workflow-based version bump behavior
  Verify: grep -rl 'MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE\|test_version_bump_uses_dso_workflow' tests/scripts/ | head -1 | grep -q .
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for new test function names
  Verify: grep '\[test_version_bump_uses_dso_workflow' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert merge-to-main-pr.sh and merge-to-main-direct.sh no longer use MERGE_TO_MAIN_PR_MODE env var
